A group of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] designed a type of '''pyramidal starship''' that was in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were pyramidal in design, and were able to pop into existence via a noiseless fluctuation in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TRG1-43" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several of the pyramidal ships attacked the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]]. The ships caused heavy damage to the freighter, which took Garnet three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of hard work to repair. Several days later, more of the ships attacked the ''Dorion Discus'' again as Garnet and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion [[Nagraoao]] were repairing damage that the ship had taken in a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor]] [[Meteor shower/Legends|storm]].<ref name="TRG1-43" />
